messages.snippet: All, The DMS (iManage) will be unavailable on Saturday 7 February from 06:00 to 11:00 for scheduled
messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Sat 7 Feb
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The DMS (iManage) will be unavailable on Saturday 7 February from 06:00 to 11:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please check in any open documents before Friday close. Email and the network will be unaffected.

Thanks
IT Helpdesk
